cases.name: void
cases.difference: Go generator rejects via template nil .Resp error; Rust emits an intentional source diagnostic.

cases.name: oneway
cases.difference: Go generator rejects via template nil .Resp error; Rust emits an intentional source diagnostic.

cases.name: throws
cases.difference: Go accepts the IDL; Rust rejects streaming throws in every service before emission. Typed streaming throws are not a wire capability.

cases.name: scalar_arg
cases.difference: Go generation/compilation succeeds, but ttstream.EncodePayload rejects non-struct messages; Rust diagnoses the unsupported message kind before emission.
